supported.part: Breathalyser公司发布的材料称，其另行测试得到了类似结果
supported.quote: Without undertaking any investigative efforts of their own, the UK tabloid The Sun made the unsupported [extrapolation](https://archive.fo/Yp610") that “just two buns would probably produce a result of more than the UK legal limit of 0.08.”

supported.part: Snopes的核查也支持即时测试可能受到这种干扰
supported.quote: [6] These claims were hogwash in the context of any properly performed breathalyzer test.

supported.part: 在测试中，一位卡车司机吹出0.000读数，然后吃了一口糕点，再次吹气后读数为0.018 BAC
supported.quote: [4] To make this point, the trucker in the video blew into a breathalyzer to produce a 0.000 reading, demonstrating that she had not consumed any alcohol. Then, after taking a bite of the pastry, she blew into the machine again directly after swallowing the food, charting a 0.018 BAC reading.

supported.part: 专业呼吸测试仪依赖于材料是100%肺泡空气的假设
supported.quote: [6] Professional breathalyzer devices such as the one shown in the above video rely on the assumption that the material being blown through them is 100% alveolar air

supported.part: 即使是微量的口腔酒精也会影响呼吸测试仪的准确性
supported.quote: Even trace amounts of alcohol in a subject's mouth would adversely affect accurate breathalyzer readings, because the machine uses the 1:2100 conversion ratio for any alcohol it detects.

supported.part: 在进行呼吸测试前，不应进食、吸烟或咀嚼任何东西15到20分钟
supported.quote: [7] “Mouth alcohol” is a well-known [complication](https://books.google.com/books?id=zTjcGQQtOGUC&printsec=frontcover&dq=breathalyzer+false+positive+dui&hl=en&sa=X&ved=0ahUKEwidjbyOrtzfAhVOS6wKHa_0BVgQ6AEIKjAA#v=onepage&q=observation%20period&f=false) for breathalyzer tests and can be easily avoided by not eating, smoking, or chewing on anything for 15 to 20 minutes before blowing into the breathalyzer.

supported.part: 糕点如热十字面包可能含有微量酒精，因为酵母将糖转化为二氧化碳和乙醇
supported.quote: [8] Pastries such as hot cross buns would likely have trace amounts of alcohol in them, as yeast [converts](https://books.google.com/books?id=HXtJivmeDfcC&pg=PA79#v=onepage&q&f=false) sugar into carbon dioxide and ethanol

supported.part: 增加更多的热十字面包不会以任何方式提高她的血液酒精含量
supported.quote: The addition of more hot cross buns, despite the claims from The Sun, would not increase her blood alcohol content in any way

supported.quote: [6] Even trace amounts of alcohol in a subject's mouth would adversely affect accurate breathalyzer readings, because the machine uses the 1:2100 conversion ratio for any alcohol it detects.

supported.part: 口腔残留酒精可以混入呼气样本，使本应用于估计血液酒精水平的读数偏高
supported.quote: [6] Even trace amounts of alcohol in a subject's mouth would adversely affect accurate breathalyzer readings, because the machine uses the 1:2100 conversion ratio for any alcohol it detects.

supported.part: 美国FMCSA指南明确承认口腔酒精会造成人为偏高的检测结果
supported.quote: [7] “Mouth alcohol” is a well-known complication for breathalyzer tests...and it is why law enforcement officers are [required](https://www.fmcsa.dot.gov/regulations/drug-alcohol-testing/implementation-guidelines-alcohol-and-drug-regulations-chapter-7), in [most jurisdiction]...to repeat any tests yielding positive readings again after a 15- to 20-minute waiting period.

supported.part: 与上述解释一致

supported.part: alcohol testing form instructions
supported.quote:
[406] Note: Use a ballpoint pen, press hard, and check all copies for legibility.

[407] - Step 1: The breath alcohol technician (BAT) or Screening Test Technician (STT) completes the information required in this step. Be sure to print the employee's name and check to box identifying the reason for the test.

[408] Note: If the employee refuses to provide a SSN or ID Number, be sure to indicate this in the remarks section in STEP 3. Proceed with STEP 2.

[409] - Step 2: Instruct the employee to read, sign, and date the employee certification statement in STEP 2

[410] Note: If the employee refuses to sign the certification statement, do not proceed with the alcohol test. Contact the designated employer representative.

[411] - Step 3: The BAT or STT completes the information required in this step and checks the type of device (saliva or breath) being used. After conducting the alcohol screening test, do the following (as appropriate):

[412] - Enter the information for the screening test (test number, testing device name, testing serial number or lot number and expiration date, time of test with any device-dependent activation times, and the results), on the front of the AFT. For a breath testing device capable of printing, the information may be part of the printed record.

[413] Note: Be sure to enter the result of the test exactly as it is indicated on the breath testing, e.g., 0.00, 0.02, 0.04, etc.

[414] - Affix the printed information in the space provided, in a tamper-evident manner (e.g., tape) or the device may print the results directly on the ATF. If the results of the screening test are less than 0.02, print, sign your name, and enter today's date in the space provided. The test process is complete.

[415] - If the results of the screening test are 0.02 or greater, a confirmation test must be administered in accordance with DOT regulations. An evidential breath testing device that is capable of printing confirmation test information must be used in conducting this test.

[416] - Ensure that a waiting period of at least 15 minutes occurs before the confirmation test begins. Check the box indicating that the waiting period lasted at least 15 minutes.

[417] - After conducting the alcohol confirmation test, affix the printed information in the space provided, in a tamper-evident manner (e.g., tape), or the device may print the results directly on the ATF. Print, sign your name, and enter the date in the space provided. Go to STEP 4.

[418] - Enter the information for the screening test (test number, testing device name, testing serial number or lot number and expiration date, time of test with any device-dependent activation times, and the results), on the front of the AFT. For a breath testing device capable of printing, the information may be part of the printed record.

[419] - Step 4: If the employee has a breath alcohol confirmation test results of 0.02 or higher, instruct the employee to read, sign, and date the employee certification statement in STEP 4.

[420] Note: If the employee refuses to sign the certification statement in STEP 4, be sure to indicate this in the remarks line in STEP 3.

[421] Immediately notify the DER if the employee has a breath alcohol confirmation test result of 0.02 or higher.

supported.part: terms and definitions
supported.quote:
[427] | Terms and Definitions |  |

[428] |---|---|

[429] | Alcohol Confirmation Test | A subsequent test using an EBT, following a screening test with a result of 0.02 or greater, that provides quantitative data about the alcohol concentration. |

[430] | Alcohol Screening Test | An analytical procedure to determine whether a driver may have a prohibited concentration of alcohol in his or her saliva or breath specimen. |

[431] | Alcohol Screening Device (ASD) | A breath or saliva device, other than an EBT, that is approved by the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) and placed on a conforming products list (CPL) for such devices. |

[432] | Breath Alcohol Technician (BAT) | An individual who instructs and assists individuals in the alcohol testing process and operates an EBT. |

[433] | Cancelled or Invalid Alcohol Test | A drug or alcohol test that has a problem identified that cannotbe or has not been corrected, or which this part otherwise requires to be cancelled. A cancelled test is neither a positive or negative test. |

[434] | Evidential Breath Testing (EBT) Device | A device approved by NHTSA for the evidential testing of breath at the .02 and .04 alcohol concentration, placed on NHTSA’s Conforming Products List (CPL) for “Evidential Breath Measurement Devices” and identified on the CPL as conforming with the model specification available from NHTSA’s Traffic Safety Program. |

[435] | Refusal to Submit to an Alcohol Test | The driver fails to provide an adequate amount of saliva or breath for testing without a valid medical explanation after he or she has received notice of the requirement for breath testing in accordance with these regulations or engages in conduct that clearly obstructs the testing process. |

[436] | Screening Test Technician (STT) | A person who instructs and assists drivers in the alcohol testing process and operates an ASD.
